evidence.boundary: Primary method references support definitions and modelling constraints only. This node contains no factor result, return claim, causal identification, or canonical experience admission.

mechanism.causal_convolution_observation_mapping: For observed history only, z_t=sum_{k=0}^{K} h_k y_{t-k}; a learned causal convolution may use dilations but must exclude y_{t+k}. It preserves a finite causal receptive-field representation and loses information outside that field unless architecture/state explicitly carries it; filtering a peak does not make that peak attention or overreaction.
mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Observed price, volume, spread or order-flow paths may combine a short-lived shock, a more persistent unobserved state, and behavior at more than one time scale. This is an observation-model question, not proof that attention, overreaction, or a causal payer has been identified.
mechanism.failure_localization: If a projected feature performs poorly, first inspect missing observations, availability timing, alignment, normalization, and projection/reconstruction loss. Do not infer that the economic hypothesis failed until these measurement alternatives and their falsifiers have been compared.
mechanism.kalman_observation_mapping: Specify x_t=F_t x_{t-1}+w_t and y_t=H_t x_t+v_t; filter x_{t|t}=x_{t|t-1}+K_t(y_t-H_t x_{t|t-1}). It preserves an explicit state/observation/noise decomposition but loses unmodelled nonlinear, non-Gaussian, or structural-break behavior. A time-varying-gain Kalman recursion can still be linear in its inputs, but it is not one single fixed convolution kernel. Only with constant F/H/K and a stated treatment of initial-state terms can its input response be written as a fixed causal kernel, generally IIR rather than finite FIR.
mechanism.mathematical_falsification_checks: Falsify the selected projection before performance interpretation: (1) compare one-sided versus centered transforms and require a legal-time match; (2) test whether state innovation/residuals retain predictable structure; (3) perturb scale, F/H/Q/R, kernel support, or lambda and reject a conclusion that exists only at an unregistered setting; (4) compare raw observation, projected feature, and reconstruction/residual to localize missing data, timing, or projection loss before changing the economic story.
mechanism.online_timing_boundary: At decision time t, feature construction, normalization, parameter fitting, and state updates may use only information whose availability time is no later than t. A centered wavelet is not inherently leakage if its entire support lies in the legal historical window; support extending beyond decision time t is leakage, and boundary padding must be disclosed. Two-sided smoothers, posterior revisions, full-sample TV tuning, or convolution padding that sees t+1 onward are future leakage unless explicitly shifted and revalidated.
mechanism.variational_tv_observation_mapping: Estimate u by argmin_u (1/2)||y-u||_2^2 + lambda TV(u), with TV(u)=sum_t |u_t-u_{t-1}| in one dimension. For an online feature at t, the optimization input window must have right endpoint no later than t and the feature must be the endpoint estimate u_t; later-window posterior revisions of historical u must never overwrite the historical tradable feature. It preserves piecewise-smooth/edge structure under its penalty and can flatten gradual variation, move change timing, or manufacture apparent plateaus when lambda is misspecified.
mechanism.wavelet_observation_mapping: For a predeclared causal window x_{t-L:t}, compute scale/location coefficients W_x(a,b)=<x,psi_{a,b}> or local energy sum_b |W_x(a,b)|^2. It preserves localized scale-time variation and can lose phase, sign, cross-scale dependence, or an economic state when compressed to energy.

relations.note: Conditional inspiration only: use a wavelet representation when localized multiscale variation is the measured object; it is not evidence of a payer, attention, or return.
Conditional inspiration only: use a state-space model when latent-state dynamics and noise assumptions are explicit and falsifiable; it is not interchangeable with a wavelet projection.
Conditional inspiration only: use a causal receptive field when an online finite-history map is the object; causal architecture alone does not establish behavioral mechanism.
Conditional inspiration only: use TV/variational regularization when the chosen structural prior is piecewise smoothness or sparse changes; the penalty is not a discovered state law.

reuse_guidance: Retrieve for 小波分析, wavelet, 卡尔曼, Kalman, 因果卷积, causal convolution, 变分, total variation, transient shock, latent state, multiscale, and online filtering questions.

Choose one method only after stating the observation equation, information time, retained/lost information, and a mathematical falsifier; record the other methods as competing projections where relevant.
Treat all four methods as conditional modelling inspiration. They cannot automatically replace one another, validate a factor, identify attention/overreaction, or justify a performance conclusion.
summary: A reference-only method map for an economic hypothesis that separates a transient shock, a persistent latent state, and multiscale motion. Wavelets, Kalman filtering, causal convolutions, and variational/total-variation regularization are competing observation models, not equivalent substitutions. They neither establish a return nor identify a market cause.
title: Transient signal models: wavelet 小波分析, Kalman 卡尔曼, causal convolution 因果卷积, and variational/TV 变分正则化
